title: Warm Maple and Elderflower Binchotan Grilled Oat Bake
description: A light, comforting Canadian-inspired dish featuring the sweetness of maple and the subtle flavor of elderflower, all without any dairy products. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a cozy brunch.

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the oats, maple syrup, elderflower syrup, non-dairy milk, coconut oil, vanilla extract, and salt. Mix well until the oats are evenly coated.
Add in the chopped almonds and dried elderflower buds, if using, and fold them into the oat mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 8x8 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Place the dish on the binchotan grill and cook for 25 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and the edges are set.
Remove the dish from the grill and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve warm, topped with additional chopped almonds and dried elderflower buds if desired.
